suggestions: I'm grateful for the CI pipeline going green on the first try after I nearly rewrote the whole test suite out of frustration.
I'm thankful for the empty MRT carriage on the way home, letting me just stare out the window and not think about work for once.
I'm grateful for my mom texting to ask if I've eaten, even though I'm turning 26 this year.
I'm thankful for the five minutes of quiet before Subuh when the house is still dark and nobody needs anything from me.
I'm grateful for a senior colleague who actually took the time to explain the legacy codebase instead of just saying 'figure it out'.
I'm thankful for teh ais tarik from the mamak downstairs that somehow tastes better after a rough standup.
I'm grateful for the rain that hit right as I finished my last deployment for the week, like the sky was clocking out with me.
I'm thankful for finding the root cause of that memory leak at 2am and actually being able to sleep after.
I'm grateful for a stable paycheck landing on time this month when so many friends are dealing with layoffs.
I'm thankful for my grandmother's cooking during raya, even the dishes I pretended to like as a kid and now actually crave.
I'm grateful for a manager who said 'take the day off' without making me feel guilty about it.
I'm thankful for the breeze at the mosque compound after Friday prayers, right before everyone rushes back to their cars.
I'm grateful for a code review comment that caught a bug before it hit production instead of after.
I'm thankful for old university friends who still reply to a random 1am voice note like no time has passed.
I'm grateful for the small win of finally understanding a concept that made no sense to me a year ago.
